lines.text: 从那以后，杰克每天早上到公司，桌上都有一杯热茶，旁边是一张小纸条：“早上好，白班的同事。”
lines.py: cóng nà yǐ hòu, Jié kè měi tiān zǎo shang dào gōng sī, zhuō shàng dōu yǒu yì bēi rè chá, páng biān shì yì zhāng xiǎo zhǐ tiáo: “zǎo shang hǎo, bái bān de tóng shì.”
lines.en: From then on, every morning when Jack gets in, there's a cup of hot tea on the desk with a little note beside it: "Good morning, day-shift colleague."
